registered_outcome_tree.FUNCTIONAL_ASYMMETRY_NOT_TRANSPORTED: All graph-backbone cells are competent and interpretable, but no alternative graph transports the complete eight-link division. Retain the original Liu-graph mechanism and reject task-class transport under this contract.
registered_outcome_tree.LIU_STRUCTURAL_MECHANISM_TRANSPORTED: All three registered alternative graphs transport. Promote the P_T/a_T asymmetry as a development-supported mechanism for the tested Liu-style task class, while retaining the claim boundary and requiring fresh backbones before population language.
registered_outcome_tree.NONINTERPRETABLE_EXECUTION: Any source, artifact, graph, GPU-runtime, tensor-freeze, shape, orientation, finite-value, or exact-reassembly integrity gate fails. Repair execution under a separately recorded lock without changing the registered science.
registered_outcome_tree.STRUCTURAL_COMPETENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Any graph-backbone cell fails either intact competence bound under otherwise valid integrity. Its mechanism result is non-interpretable; do not tune the graph, model, gain, temperature, or threshold.
registered_outcome_tree.TOPOLOGY_DEPENDENT_OR_UNRESOLVED: One or two registered graphs transport while another competent graph fails one or more mechanism links, or a link is heterogeneous across competent backbones. Localize the preregistered graph property before any new graph or intervention; do not add graphs post hoc.
registered_outcome_tree.cell: Evaluate all eight links independently for each registered graph in each mandatory backbone. A graph-backbone cell passes only if every link passes and all source, artifact, graph, runtime, tensor-freeze, orientation, finite-value, and local-exactness integrity gates pass.
registered_outcome_tree.graph: A graph transports only if all three mandatory backbones pass its cell. No majority-over-networks rule is permitted.

registered_primary_links.P_off_a_on_direct_nontransitive: The P-off/a-on learned correct-probability bootstrap lower bound exceeds 0.50 and the paired bootstrap lower bound for learned minus nonlearned correct probability exceeds zero.
registered_primary_links.P_off_global_collapse: The P-off/a-on nonlearned correct-probability bootstrap upper bound is at most 0.55 and the bootstrap upper bound of P-off/local disjoint LOO influence minus 0.25 times intact a-off global disjoint LOO influence is below zero.
registered_primary_links.P_remote_reassembly: On the intact a-off global field, participant-bootstrap lower bounds for mean absolute disjoint relation-LOO influence and third-party relational potential-energy fraction both exceed zero.
registered_primary_links.a_off_direct_loss: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for intact minus a-off learned correct probability exceeds zero.
registered_primary_links.constructive_global_structure: Both intact and a-off Hodge gradient-energy-fraction lower bounds are at least 0.95, the intact transitive-triplet-fraction lower bound is at least 0.95, and the intact Hodge-order Kendall-tau lower bound exceeds zero.
registered_primary_links.exact_local_compression: Every finite-value and shape gate passes, and tensor-state and all-query raw-read reconstruction maximum absolute errors are each at most 1e-6.
registered_primary_links.individualized_stable_structure: The sampled-policy analysis contains at least two non-correct eligible subjects, its bootstrap upper bound for mean inter-subject Kendall tau is below 0.80, and its bootstrap lower bound for 80-percent stable-error prevalence among eligible non-correct subjects is at least 0.80.
registered_primary_links.intact_competence: Both participant-bootstrap lower bounds for intact learned and nonlearned exact decision accuracy exceed 0.50.
